caption: The drawing shows two oval-shaped objects positioned side by side in the center of a cream or light beige background, both enclosed within a thin rectangular border. The object on the left is an ornate, gold-toned piece with intricate patterns, including a pair of symmetrical swirling designs and fine detailing around the edges, as well as small, raised elements that contribute to its textured, decorative appearance. The object on the right is similarly oval in shape and golden in color but has a simpler, less detailed design, with two oval cutouts and a horizontal bar crossing through the middle, giving it a more structured, functional look. Both objects are rendered in shades of gold and brown, and their shadows create a sense of depth against the plain background.
title: Buckle
